description.p: You cause the Shield used in this spell's casting to spring to life, flying of its own accord to defend you and your allies for the duration. The Shield animates in an unoccupied space of your choice within range. While it is animated, the Shield gives each creature of your choice within 5 feet of it a +2 bonus to AC if it is not wielding a Shield. The animate shield is a Small Construct with an AC equal to 12 plus your spellcasting ability modifier, 20 Hit Points, and Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage and all conditions.
As a Bonus Action on your later turns, you can cause the animate shield to fly up to 30 feet. This spell ends early if the animate shield is reduced to 0 Hit Points.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The animate shield's Hit Points increase by 10 for each spell slot level above 2.

setters.set: bonus action, construct, upcasting, higher-level spell slot

description.p: You cause the weapon used in this spell's casting to spring to life, flying of its own accord to harass and harm your enemies for the duration. The weapon animates in an unoccupied space of your choice within range. While it persists, at the start of each of your turns, the animate weapon makes one attack against a target of your choice within 5 feet (if it is a Melee weapon without the Reach property), 10 feet (if it is a Melee weapon with the Reach property), or the weapon's Range (if it is a Ranged weapon or Melee weapon with the Thrown property). The weapon uses your spellcasting ability modifier for the attack and damage rolls instead of using Strength or Dexterity. The animate weapon is a Small Construct with an AC equal to 10 plus your spellcasting ability modifier, 20 Hit Points, and Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage and all conditions.
As a Bonus Action on your later turns, you can cause the animate weapon to fly up to 30 feet. This spell ends early if the animate weapon is reduced to 0 Hit Points.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The animate weapon's Hit Points increase by 10 for each spell slot level above 2.

description.p: You sacrifice your life force to weave a mystic defense. Roll one or two of your unexpended Hit Point Dice, and gain a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to the roll's total plus your spellcasting ability modifier. Those dice are then expended.

ul.li: You know if the target is Bloodied.
Your attack rolls against the target score a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20 on the d20.
When the target attacks you, you can use your Reaction to give the attack Disadvantage.

Cantrip Upgrade. The damage increases by 1d8 when you reach levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).

description.p: Ethereal strings spring from your fingers and wrap around the limbs of the triggering creature. If the creature is not a Construct or Undead, and doesn't have a Challenge Rating of 7+ ,it immediately dies if it is not already dead and, at the start of your next turn, you can instruct it where to move, choosing which of its Speeds to use (no action required). You can use a Bonus Action to issue a command for it to use an action of your choice from its stat block (except for casting a spell). This spell ends at the end of your turn.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The maximum Challenge Rating of a creature you can target with the spell increases by 3 for each spell slot level above 2.

You complete one task that you can complete within 8 hours and that doesn't require interacting with another creature, in a pocket outside of time, such as traveling across a city, crafting an item, or reading a book. The stress of being nearly outside the flow of time prevents you from taking a Short or Long Rest while in the temporal pocket.

After you make the attack, the object teleports back to the demiplane it came from.

While a creature is ensorcelled, it has Disadvantage on saving throws against spells, and spell attacks against it have Advantage. A target is no longer ensorcelled if it fails a saving throw against a spell or is hit by a spell attack.

Though the mortal mind cannot master such speech, you can temporarily learn it using this spell. For the duration you gain the ability to comprehend and verbally communicate with all creatures and plants, and whenever you make a Charisma (Deception, Intimidation, or Persuasion) check, you gain a bonus to the check equal to your spellcasting ability modifier (minimum of +1).

On a failed save, you deflect the spell, choosing a new target, targets, or area for it as if you had cast the spell from your space. Once redirected, the spell is resolved as normal.

If this damage reduces the aegis to 0 Hit Points, the aegis is destroyed and the spell ends early.
